summary: A bare governance-check on a ticket branch validates its committed range (issue 520)

delivery.outcome: ./project/governance-check.sh without --base on a ticket/NNN-* branch validates from git merge-base HEAD origin/<target>, so a committed ticket without a delivery contract fails locally with GOV-DELIVERY-001 instead of passing; a branch without origin/<target> fails with GOV-BASE-001.
nonGoals: No change for explicit --base or --changed-file callers, other branches or detached CI checkouts
No change to the pytest plugin, which already passes --base
No inference from adoption tickets beyond the existing resolve_validation_base rule

architecture.decision: governance_check.py gains --infer-ticket-base: before the preflight cache key, when no --base or --changed-file is given and HEAD is on ticket/NNN-*, infer_ticket_branch_base takes the single manifest delivery target (or the ticket intent's targetBranch among several), binds --base to the merge-base with refs/remotes/origin/<target>, prints it on stderr, and reports GOV-BASE-001 when it cannot. Both managed wrappers pass the flag; the bundled Wellman copy stays identical.
interfaceChanges: governance-check.sh/.bat bare run on a ticket branch binds its range
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; a bare run checks the working tree only, as before.
